summary: The customer is unable to log into their account because the magic link email is not arriving despite multiple attempts.
formal:
Hello,

We understand that you are experiencing difficulties receiving the magic link to log into your account. Please check your spam and promotions folders, as the email may have been filtered there. Additionally, please note that links expire after 15 minutes and only the latest link will work. Please also consider that corporate mail filters sometimes block these messages. If you still cannot sign in after following these steps, please reply with your device model, operating system version, and application version so we can escalate your case to technical support.

Best regards, Nebula Support
empathetic: It can be really frustrating when you're trying to log in and the magic link email just won't show up after multiple tries. Please double-check your spam and promotions folders, or see if a corporate mail filter might be blocking it. Keep in mind that links expire after 15 minutes and only the newest link is valid. If it still doesn't work, just let us know your device model, OS version, and app version, and we'll escalate this to our tech team to get you sorted out.
short: Please check your spam, promotions folders, and corporate filters; remember links expire in 15 minutes and only the latest works. If issues persist, reply with your device model, OS version, and app version for tech escalation.
